pieces.name: BT_Screwdriver
pieces.what: screwdriver: the blade's edge is the origin; turn about Y at a screw

pieces.name: BT_Tweezers
pieces.what: tweezers: the points are the origin; Leaf_L and Leaf_R turn about their own axis to pinch

pieces.name: BT_Brush
pieces.what: brush: the bristles' ends are the origin; strokes along the surface

blend_shapes.Bend: 0..1 from the stroke's speed and the press: the clumps bend from the ferrule's mouth, their ends 25 degrees off and 7.4 mm toward -X (they trail a stroke along +X); the tips stay on y 0 (the origin contract holds bent) and splay 2 mm

pieces.name: BT_PryTool
pieces.what: pry tool: the blade's edge is the origin; the lever goes in flat along -Y

pieces.name: BT_Cloth
pieces.what: cloth, folded (on the rest): its face on the glass is the origin; wiped in circles
pieces.rests: folded on the rest's cork at Seat_Cloth, its free corner lifted 6 mm toward the player (the grab point)

pieces.name: BT_ClothHeld
pieces.what: cloth in the hand: a wad, the pad's face on the glass the origin; keys Press and Bunch (stroke along +X)
pieces.place: a second model under Tool_Cloth (the ToolPickup), shown while the cloth is in the hand: the folded BT_Cloth is hidden and BT_ClothHeld shown at the cursor's contact point (the swap is hidden by the pick-up motion)
pieces.rests: its pad's face on the glass (origin, y 0); the tail rises +Y and leans toward Unity -Z (the player)

blend_shapes.Press: 0..1 from the press: the pad 40 x 45 -> 50 x 52 mm, the tail 5 mm lower
blend_shapes.Bunch: 0..1 from the stroke's speed (Audio's reference px/s): the leading edge (+X) rolls up 4 mm in three folds, the trailing edge (-X) drags 9 mm, the tail leans 12 degrees toward -X

pieces.name: BT_ToolRest
pieces.what: tool rest: the five tools' seats (Seat_*) as children, its origin the bottom centre; no turn in the rig
pieces.place: under the InspectRig's stage, local rotation 0 (built in the rig's frame: +X the player's right, +Z away), its bottom on the mat's top; centre x per device (bench_stage.json per_device tool_rest_x), z 0 on the mat's centre line. Replaces the 'Tool caddy' block. Each tool's slot takes its Seat_* pose (local to the rest)
pieces.rests: flat on the mat; the tools lie on its two bars (each U notch fitted to its tool: both bars touched, 0.0 mm)

pieces.name: BT_ScrapTray
pieces.what: old-parts tray: its origin the bottom centre; it stands on the mat's far band behind the device
pieces.place: under the InspectRig's stage, local rotation 0, on the mat's top at the device's scrap_tray_centre (bench_stage.json per_device); the old-parts bin the auto-tray flies broken parts into
pieces.rests: flat on the mat; its floor's top is 0.8 mm up (where a broken part lands); Slot_1..3 are Systems' scrapSlots

note: Unity (x, y, z) = Blender (-x, z, -y). A tool's origin is its working tip. The rest and the tray are built in the bench rig's frame (no turn under the stage). Empties: children with no mesh, named; their 'at' is the local position and 'quaternion_xyzw' / 'euler' the local rotation as Unity will import them. Shape keys: import with importBlendShapes = true (Bench tools 1 sets it false today).
